hero.subheadline: Automatically convert documentation websites, GitHub repositories, and PDF files into production-ready skills for any LLM platform—Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, and more.

about.heading: What is Skill Seekers?
about.description: Skill Seekers is an open-source Python tool that automatically converts documentation websites, GitHub repositories, and PDF files into production-ready AI skills for Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, and other LLM platforms.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.item1: Manually copying documentation into AI chat contexts is tedious and error-prone
problem.item2: Large codebases and documentation exceed AI context window limits
problem.item3: AI responses lack framework-specific knowledge and best practices
problem.item4: Keeping AI knowledge up-to-date with framework changes is time-consuming

solution.title: The Solution
solution.item1: Automatically extract from docs, GitHub repos, and PDFs with multi-source analysis
solution.item2: Intelligent chunking, categorization, and Three-Stream Analysis (Code, Docs, Insights)
solution.item3: AI-enhanced skills with explanations, examples, and best practices
solution.item4: Deploy to any LLM platform (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) in 20-40 minutes

speed.title: 10x Faster Development
speed.description: Stop copying docs manually. Generate comprehensive skills in minutes, not hours.

expertise.title: Framework Expertise
expertise.description: Give AI assistants deep knowledge of any framework with API references and examples.

uptodate.title: Always Up-to-Date
uptodate.description: Re-run when docs update. Keep your AI knowledge fresh and accurate.

quickstart.title: Get Started in 3 Steps
quickstart.subtitle: From zero to production-ready skill in 20-40 minutes

steps.title: 2. Scrape Docs
steps.description: Use preset configs or create your own
steps.code:
skill-seekers scrape --config react
# Or from URL directly
skill-seekers scrape --url https://react.dev --name react

steps.title: 3. Package & Upload
steps.code:
skill-seekers package output/react/
skill-seekers upload react.zip

# Done! Your skill is ready to use
